description: Adjoining a gives the least Boolean filter containing F and a; it is proper exactly when every f meet a is nonzero, equivalently when a complement is absent from F.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin_spec.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (F : Order.PFilter B) (a : B) :
  Order.IsPFilter (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin F a) ∧
    ↑F ⊆ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin F a ∧
      a ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin F a ∧
        (∀ (G : Order.PFilter B), F ≤ G → a ∈ G → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin F a ⊆ ↑G) ∧
          (⊥ ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin F a ↔ ∀ f ∈ F, f ⊓ a ≠ ⊥) ∧
            (⊥ ∉ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.adjoin F a ↔ aᶜ ∉ F)
